In [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]], [[Xanatos]] owned a '''private office''' on the [[Mining/Legends|mining]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Bandomeer/Legends|Bandomeer]]. To access the office, a code was needed. The code was "[[Crion]]," the name of Xanatos' deceased father.

[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], Xanatos' former master, had reasons to believe Xanatos was causing trouble on the planet so he decided to find answers in his office. Taking a guess, he entered Crion as the code.
